Eda: base class for exploratory data analysis on database tables

Eda-class.Rd

Mother class for EDA model objects. It stores the connection information of a database table which is initialised from a credentials.yml at the root of the project.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'Eda'
initialize(.Object, base = list(), root_path = character(0L), ...)

# S4 method for class 'Eda'
show(object)

Arguments

.Object

An Eda object.

base

list. base list. Named list with elements database, host, port, user and password. If empty (default), it is read from credentials.yml in root_path.#'

root_path

character(1). Project root. Defaults to here::here().

...

Passed to the next initialize method.

object

An object of class eda

Slots

base

list. A list with names database, host, port, user, password that holds DBI connexion information.

root_path

character. The path to root, credentials.yml is searched when base is not supplied. #' @section Validity: base must return a string of length 5 and contain database, host, port, user, and password. and port must be numeric. root_path must have length 1.

credentials.yml

Create a text file named credentials.yml at the root of the project:

database: name_of_the_database
host: 127.0.0.1
port: 5432
user: myuser
password: mypassword

Do not commit this file to git.

See also

loaddb()

Author

Cedric Briand cedric.briand@eaux-et-vilaine.bzh

Examples

# An example setting initial string
obj <- new("Eda", list("database" = "my_database", "host" = "localhost",
"port" = 5432,"user" = "postgres", "password" = "Monpetitsecret" ))
obj
#> <Eda>
#>   root_path: /home/runner/work/eda/eda
#>   database: my_database
#>   host: localhost
#>   port: 5432
#>   user: postgres
#>   password: ****
# Reading a credentials file
if (requireNamespace("yaml", quietly = TRUE)) {
dir <-  withr::local_tempdir()
 base <- list(
   database = "my_database",
   host     = "localhost",
   port     = 5432,
   user     = "postgres",
   password = "mon_petit_secret_bien_garde"
   )
 yaml::write_yaml(base, file.path(dir,"credentials.yml"))
 obj <- new("Eda", root_path = dir)
 print(obj) # shows the content of the object
 }
#> <Eda>
#>   root_path: /tmp/RtmpMyO8w3/file182119ba352f
#>   database: my_database
#>   host: localhost
#>   port: 5432
#>   user: postgres
#>   password: ****
